verdict: Mee soto is the better choice for losing weight. It has fewer calories, more protein and a lighter broth.
why: Mee soto is about 400 kcal. Mee rebus is about 550 kcal.
Mee soto has about 22 g protein, mee rebus 18 g. The shredded chicken in soto helps you stay full longer.
Mee soto has about 10 g fat, mee rebus 20 g. Mee rebus gravy is thick with peanuts and sweet potato.
Clear soto broth is easy to sip without adding many calories. Thick mee rebus gravy packs more calories.
when_a: Mee rebus is okay for breakfast or tea time once in a while. Add a boiled egg for protein.
when_b: Mee soto suits a normal lunch or dinner, including on workdays.
tip: Ask for extra chicken or egg, a bit less noodles, and go easy on extra bergedil and kerepek (crackers).

faq.q: Is the bergedil in soto high in calories?
faq.a: Bergedil is fried, so one piece can add around 100 kcal or more. Just take one if you're craving it.

faq.q: Is mee rebus a no-go when dieting?
faq.a: It's fine, just have it less often. A normal bowl with a boiled egg can still fit into your plan.
